chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality: Keke's Homecoming to the Fallen Cosmic Tree
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen follows Keke to a mountain of dragons and discovers the fallen Cosmic Tree, revealing Keke's tragic origin as a lone orphan of a destroyed world.

og_description: In this poignant chapter, Xiao Chen finds Keke's birthplace—a colossal fallen tree—and witnesses the divine beast's rare moment of grief.
